caption: From study to first contact: learn the pool, find a session, pass the 35-question exam, pay the $35 FCC fee online, and transmit once your grant appears in the ULS.
spoken: This figure shows the path from studying the question pool, to finding an exam session, passing the thirty-five-question exam, paying the thirty-five-dollar FCC fee, and finally getting on the air once the grant appears in the ULS.
